ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); pointer-events: none;

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); pointer-events: none;

foreignObject.style: overflow: visible; text-align: left; pointer-events: none;

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-end; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 41; margin-left: 45; pointer-events: none;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: center; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: var(--panel-color); pointer-events: none;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: none; background-color: light-dark(var(--panel-color), var(--dark-panel-color)); white-space: nowrap;
